ProductId.description: Unique identifier of the [Product](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/products/#product) of the original rebated [Order item](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/orderitems/#order-item).

RebatedItemId.description: Unique identifier of [Order item](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/orderitems/#order-item) which has been rebated by current item.
